items.name: Peppermint Balm, 1 oz
items.blurb: Organic chamomile oil and beeswax with peppermint essential oil, to rub under the nose or on the chest for a cool, clearing breath. Keep away from the eyes.

items.name: Witch Hazel Herbal Oil, 1 fl oz
items.blurb: Organic witch hazel leaves infused in organic sunflower oil: a natural astringent and moisturizer that helps skin hold its moisture.

items.name: Patchouli Herbal Oil, 1 fl oz

items.name: Calendula Herbal Oil, 1 fl oz

items.name: Arnica Oil, 1 fl oz

items.name: Herbal Diaper Balm

items.name: Herbal Pregnancy & Postpartum Balm
items.blurb: Herbal oils with a high level of tannins in a moisturizing balm that helps stretching skin stay hydrated and supple, during pregnancy and after.

items.name: Comfrey & Arnica Salve
